newsitem.title: USA: Elcotel to license "smart" phone technology.
newsitem.headline: Elcotel to license "smart" phone technology.

text.p: Elcotel Inc said on Tuesday it plans to license its "smart" pay phone technology to Lucent Technologies to help bring next-generation, smart pay phone technology to international pay phone service providers.

A statement issued by Elcotel said under the three-year agreement Lucent will make and sell its smart pay phones, with Elcotel's newest microprocessor-controlled modules and software for use in international telephone networks.

"There is no specific number of phones guaranteed under this contract, so there's no dollar amount attatched to the contract," said Elcotel Chief Executive C. Shelton James in a telephone interview. "We anticipate several hundred thousand phones to be sold over the next three to five years. A typical phone sells between $1,000 and $1,500, which would be revenue shared by Elcotel and Lucent."
